This document tracks a structural code review of the two core TF24 hydraulics
sources — `src/leaf_model.cpp` (the plant hydraulic solver) and
`src/tf24_strategy.cpp` (the strategy/allocation layer that drives it). It is a
companion to the performance log in
[`test-root.qmd`](test-root.qmd) (*Implementation & performance notes*); where a
finding overlaps with that log, it is cross-referenced.

The focus is **structure, clarity and maintainability**, with speed called out
only where the existing profiling supports it. Several of these touch the
numerically sensitive hot path; per the workflow in `test-root.qmd`, any change
to spline construction or the solver must be validated **bit-identically** (or
its trajectory shift quantified) before it is considered done.

## Status legend

- **TODO** — identified, not started
- **WIP** — in progress
- **DONE** — implemented and validated
- **REJECTED** — tried or considered, not worth it (with reason)

## Notes on individual items

### #2 — reusable `mass_root_prop_` buffer (DONE)

Promoted the per-call `std::vector<double> mass_root_prop_` to a member of
`TF24_Strategy` and reuse it with `assign(n, 0.0)` each call (the same pattern
`Leaf::set_physiology` uses for `c_r_V_` etc.).

**This is a code-hygiene change, not a speed win.** The performance log in
`test-root.qmd` explicitly profile-confirms that "the per-call `mass_root_prop_`
/ `psi_soil_inverted_` allocations … are <0.1% of runtime; preallocating them
will not move the needle." Implemented anyway because removing a per-call heap
allocation is cheap, low-risk, and consistent with the rest of the code. Output
is bit-identical by construction (no arithmetic changed).

### #5 — shared cumulative-integral spline builder (DONE)

`setup_transpiration` and `setup_root_vulnerability` both built `{0, step, …}`
knot grids and seeded a cumulative vulnerability integral
`G(m) = ∫₀ᵐ exp(-(s/b)^c) ds` from the gamma closed form
`(b/c)·tgamma_lower(1/c, (m/b)^c)` (issue #468). Factored that shared build into
a private helper `build_cumulative_vulnerability_integral(b, c, resolution, …)`.
The differing parts stay in each caller: roots also build the `f_r`
conductivity spline (extrapolate **on**, no inverse); transpiration also builds
the inverse `psi_from_transpiration` (extrapolate **off**, no `f_r`).

**Bit-identical by construction** — the helper reproduces each original loop
exactly (`0.0 + step == step`; same `pow`/`tgamma_lower` expressions; same
accumulation order). `f_r[0]` is now computed as `exp(-pow(0/b, c)) = 1.0`
rather than hard-coded `1.0` — identical in IEEE. Validate with the
`run_scm_collect` self-comparison from `test-root.qmd` before final sign-off.

### #8 — member-shadowing local (DONE)

`profit_psi_stem_Sperry` / `profit_psi_stem_TF` declared a local
`double hydraulic_cost_` shadowing the `Leaf::hydraulic_cost_` member (which the
`hydraulic_cost_*` callees already write). Renamed the locals to `cost` to
remove the shadow. No behaviour change.

### #6 — shared shut-down-state helper (DONE)

`find_root_collar_psi` had the same three-line "shut down at psi_crit" block
(`root_collar_psi_ = …; opt_psi_stem_ = psi_crit; profit_ = -R_d_ -
hydraulic_cost_TF(psi_crit)`) inlined at three early-exits, differing only in the
recorded collar potential. Extracted `Leaf::set_shutdown_state(double
root_collar)`; the three sites become `set_shutdown_state(...); return;`.
Bit-identical by construction. (The fourth, `assim_max_ < 0`, exit is a genuinely
different operating point and was left as-is.)

### #11 — naming / hygiene (DONE)

- `evapotranspiration_dt(double, int soil_depth)` → `soil_layer` (it is a layer
  index, not a depth), header + definition.
- `compute_rates` soil loop changed from `size_t i` to `int i` to match the
  `int soil_number_of_depths_` bound (removes a signed/unsigned comparison).
- Completed the truncated `compute_average_light_environment` comment: it states
  the value is clamped to a small positive floor (1e-4); the original rationale
  was never recorded, so that is noted rather than invented.

### #1 — temperature/O2-param cache (DONE — clarity, NOT a speed win)

`set_physiology` recomputed `vcmax_, jmax_, gamma_, ko_, kc_, R_d_, km_` (≈8
Arrhenius transcendentals) every call, though they are pure functions of
`(leaf_temp_, atm_o2_kpa_)`. Now cached on that key (`photo_temp_cached_`),
recomputed only when the key changes, invalidated in `setup_clean_leaf`.
`electron_transport_` is deliberately **excluded** — it also depends on the
per-call `PPFD_`, so it is still computed every call.

**Bit-identical, but measured as a speed wash** (A/B on the 15-layer MPL=5
scenario, median of 5): baseline 6.98 s vs cached 7.07 s — no gain, within noise.
This matches the Phase 2 profile in `test-root.qmd`: `set_physiology` is not on
the hot path (the nested solver dominates), so caching ~8 transcendentals that
run once per `net_mass_production_dt` saves noise-level work. `offspring_production`
and the full-trajectory digest are identical (1.64927177539e-06 / 164392.960996).

**Kept anyway** — it removes a genuinely redundant recomputation and is exact;
the value is code clarity, not speed. (See the Phase-3 note in `test-root.qmd`.)

### #9 / #10 — named constants + unit-divergence documentation (DONE, bit-identical)

**#9** — replaced the hard-coded root-distribution magic numbers in
`net_mass_production_dt` with named file-scope constants:
`root_mass_carbon_scale = 83.26 * 0.5`, `root_depth_shape_eta = 0.2`,
`rooting_depth_max = 1.5`. Per the scope decision, these stay C++ constants;
promotion to user-tunable RcppR6 traits is a deliberate **follow-up**, not done.

**#10** — introduced `kg_per_mol_h2o = 0.018015` (in `leaf_model.h`, next to
`kg_to_mol_h2o`) and used it at both conversion sites (`E_up_` in
`E_from_Soil_to_Root_Collar`; the per-layer consumption rate in `compute_rates`).
Added a comment at each site spelling out the **intentional** unit divergence:
aggregate `E_up_` is kg, per-layer `soil_consumption_[i]` is mol (converted
downstream). Units were *not* unified, because moving the kg conversion inside
the per-layer loop would reorder the `E_up_` summation and break bit-identicality.

**The `60*60*12*365` unit factor was deliberately left inline.** Collapsing the
4-step integer product into a single `double` constant changes the FP rounding,
and the adaptive ODE amplifies it (`offspring_production` shifted +0.18%,
1.64927e−06 → 1.65220e−06 in the A/B). A comment documents the duplication and
why it stays inline. With the factor kept inline and the value-preserving renames
above, the final build is **bit-identical** (offspring_production and the full
15-layer MPL=5 trajectory digest match HEAD exactly: 1.64927177539e−06 /
164392.960996).

## Suggested ordering for the rest

1. **#7** — the sign-convention cleanup is the highest-value correctness work but
   also the riskiest; do it last, with the full validation sweep.
2. **#9 follow-up** — promote `root_mass_carbon_scale` / `root_depth_shape_eta` /
   `rooting_depth_max` to RcppR6 traits if user-tunability is wanted (interface
   change + `make rebuild`).
3. **#3 / #4** — already resolved/rejected; see the performance log.
